# Count

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Counts different things within the given input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
count(type: <#Enumeration (WFCountType)#>, input: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
count(type: Items, input: Names)
~~~~
